Atomic_Propositions: P_14_211_3_a_3_i: Proposals safeguarded against unauthorized disclosure; P_14_211_3_a_3_ii: Data handled per parts 15 and 27; P_14_211_3_a_3_iii: Price/cost references removed
Validation_Notes: Three conjunctive mandatory duties upon receipt. 'Must' is unambiguous.

Natural_Language: The contracting officer must establish a time period for evaluating technical proposals. The period may vary with the complexity and number of proposals. However, the evaluation should be completed quickly.
Atomic_Propositions: P_14_211_3_a_4_a: CO establishes evaluation time period; P_14_211_3_a_4_b: Evaluation should be completed quickly
Validation_Notes: Mandatory establishment of time period ('must') combined with advisory timeliness standard ('should'). PENDING_REVIEW due to advisory 'should' component.

Natural_Language: Base evaluations on the criteria in the request for proposals but not consideration of responsibility as defined in part 9. Categorize technical proposals as: (A) Acceptable; (B) Reasonably susceptible of being made acceptable; or (C) Unacceptable. Any proposal that modifies, or fails to conform to the essential requirements or specifications of, the request for technical proposals is unacceptable.
Atomic_Propositions: P_14_211_3_a_5_a: Evaluations based on criteria in request, not responsibility per part 9; P_14_211_3_a_5_b: Proposals categorized as acceptable, reasonably susceptible, or unacceptable; P_14_211_3_a_5_c: Proposals modifying or failing to conform to essential requirements are unacceptable
Validation_Notes: Three conjunctive evaluation rules. Categorization is exhaustive (three categories). Nonconforming proposals are mandatorily categorized as unacceptable.

Natural_Language: CO may proceed directly with step two if sufficient acceptable proposals ensure adequate price competition and further effort would not be in Government's interest. Otherwise must request additional info from bidders whose proposals may be made acceptable. Must identify deficiencies. May arrange discussions. Do not discuss with other than submitter. When requesting additional info, establish appropriate time; may extend due date. If additional info makes proposal acceptable, update category.
Atomic_Propositions: P_14_211_3_a_6_a: CO may proceed to step two if sufficient proposals; P_14_211_3_a_6_b: Otherwise CO must request additional info; P_14_211_3_a_6_c: Must identify deficiency nature; P_14_211_3_a_6_d: May arrange discussions; P_14_211_3_a_6_e: Do not discuss with non-submitters; P_14_211_3_a_6_f: Establish time for additional info; P_14_211_3_a_6_g: May extend due date; P_14_211_3_a_6_h: Update category if info makes proposal acceptable
Validation_Notes: Complex multi-path provision. Disjunction between proceeding directly or requesting info. Several mandatory and permissive sub-requirements. Discussion prohibition is absolute. PENDING_REVIEW due to mixed mandatory/permissive elements.

Natural_Language: When a technical proposal is found unacceptable (either initially or after clarification), the contracting officer must promptly notify the bidder of the basis of the determination and that a revision of the technical proposal will not be considered. Upon written request, the contracting officer must debrief unsuccessful bidders (see part 15).
Atomic_Propositions: P_14_211_3_a_7_cond: Technical proposal found unacceptable; P_14_211_3_a_7_a: CO promptly notifies bidder of basis; P_14_211_3_a_7_b: Notification states revision not considered; P_14_211_3_a_7_c: CO debriefs upon written request per part 15
Validation_Notes: Conditional: unacceptability triggers three mandatory duties. Debrief is conditional on written request but duty to provide it is mandatory when requested.

Natural_Language: Late technical proposals are governed by part 15.
Atomic_Propositions: P_14_211_3_a_8_a: Late technical proposals processed per part 15
Validation_Notes: Simple cross-reference to Part 15 for late proposal handling.

Natural_Language: If it is necessary to discontinue two-step sealed bidding, the contracting officer must include a statement of the facts and circumstances in the contract file. The contracting officer must notify each bidder in writing. When step one results in no acceptable technical proposals or only one acceptable technical proposal, the acquisition may be continued by negotiation.
Atomic_Propositions: P_14_211_3_a_9_cond: Necessary to discontinue two-step; P_14_211_3_a_9_a: Statement of facts in contract file; P_14_211_3_a_9_b: Written notification to each bidder; P_14_211_3_a_9_c: No acceptable or only one acceptable proposal; P_14_211_3_a_9_d: Acquisition may continue by negotiation
Justification_Rules: Material Implication (Impl): Rule 15 [HIGH-RISK]; Conjunction (Conj): Rule 7; Tautology (Taut): Rule 18
Validation_Notes: Two conditional structures: discontinuation triggers mandatory documentation and notification; insufficient proposals create permissive authority to negotiate (tautology for discretion).

Natural_Language: Follow sealed bidding procedures except that invitations for bids in step two must: (i) Be issued only to those that submitted acceptable technical proposals in step one; (ii) Include the provision prescribed in 14.207(o); (iii) Clearly state bidder must comply with specifications and technical proposal; and (iv) Not be synopsized through GPE or publicly posted.
Atomic_Propositions: P_14_211_3_b_1_i: IFBs issued only to acceptable step one bidders; P_14_211_3_b_1_ii: Include 14.207(o) provision; P_14_211_3_b_1_iii: State compliance with specs and technical proposal required; P_14_211_3_b_1_iv: Not synopsized or publicly posted
Validation_Notes: Four conjunctive mandatory requirements for step two IFBs. Item (iv) is a prohibition (negation of synopsization/posting). All are 'must' requirements.

Natural_Language: List the names of firms that submitted acceptable proposals in step one through the GPE for the benefit of prospective subcontractors (see 5.201).
Atomic_Propositions: P_14_211_3_b_2_a: Names of firms with acceptable step one proposals listed through GPE for subcontractors
Validation_Notes: Mandatory listing requirement for subcontractor benefit. Cross-reference to 5.201.

Natural_Language: Submission, modification, or withdrawal of bids.
Atomic_Propositions: P_14_301: Bid submission, modification, and withdrawal rules encompass timing, methods, receiving procedures, withdrawal procedures, late bids, evidence, emergency extensions, notification, and documentation
Validation_Notes: Parent proposition for section 14.301.

Natural_Language: Bidders are responsible for submitting bids, and any modifications or withdrawals not later than the exact time set for opening of bids. If no time is specified in the IFB, the time for receipt is 4:30 p.m., local time, for the designated Government office on the date that bids are due.
Atomic_Propositions: P_14_301_a_1: Bidders responsible for timely submission of bids, modifications, and withdrawals; P_14_301_a_2: If no time specified, default is 4:30 p.m. local time
Validation_Notes: Mandatory timing requirement with default fallback. Bidder bears responsibility. 4:30 p.m. default only applies when IFB is silent on time.

Natural_Language: Bids may be modified or withdrawn by any method authorized by the IFB.
Atomic_Propositions: P_14_301_b_a: Bids may be modified or withdrawn by IFB-authorized method
Validation_Notes: Permissive 'may' for bidders. Method must be IFB-authorized. Simple atomic.

Natural_Language: The receiving official receiving a paper bid submission, modification or withdrawal must: (1) Write on the envelope (i) the date and time of receipt and by whom; and (ii) the invitation for bid number; (2) Sign the envelope; (3) Not disclose bid information before the time set for bid opening (see part 3).
Atomic_Propositions: P_14_301_c_1_i: Date/time/recipient written on envelope; P_14_301_c_1_ii: IFB number written on envelope; P_14_301_c_2: Envelope signed; P_14_301_c_3: Bid info not disclosed before opening
Validation_Notes: Four conjunctive duties for receiving official. All mandatory ('must'). Item (3) is a prohibition.

Natural_Language: A bidder or its authorized representative may withdraw a paper bid submission in person if, before the exact time set for opening of bids, the identity of the persons requesting withdrawal is established and that person signs a receipt for the bid.
Atomic_Propositions: P_14_301_d_cond1: Before exact opening time; P_14_301_d_cond2: Identity established; P_14_301_d_cond3: Person signs receipt; P_14_301_d_act: Paper bid withdrawn in person
Justification_Rules: Material Implication (Impl): Rule 15 [HIGH-RISK]; Conjunction (Conj): Rule 7; Tautology (Taut): Rule 18
Validation_Notes: Permissive 'may' with three conjunctive conditions. All must be met for withdrawal eligibility. Tautology for discretion (bidder's choice, not CO's).

Natural_Language: A bidder may withdraw an electronically submitted bid if notice is received in the office designated in the IFB not later than the exact time set for opening of bids. Upon withdrawal of an electronically transmitted bid, the data received must not be viewed and, to the maximum extent practical, must be purged from primary and backup data storage systems.
Atomic_Propositions: P_14_301_e_cond: Withdrawal notice received before opening time; P_14_301_e_a: Electronic bid withdrawn; P_14_301_e_b: Data must not be viewed; P_14_301_e_c: Data purged from storage to maximum extent practical
Justification_Rules: Material Implication (Impl): Rule 15 [HIGH-RISK]; Conjunction (Conj): Rule 7; Tautology (Taut): Rule 18
Validation_Notes: Permissive withdrawal with mandatory data protection duties if exercised. Tautology for bidder choice. If withdrawal occurs, two mandatory duties: no viewing and purging.

Natural_Language: Any bid, modification, or withdrawal received at the Government office after the exact time specified for receipt is late and will not be considered unless: (i) received before award is made; and (ii) the CO determines accepting would not unduly delay; and (A) if electronic, received at initial point of entry not later than 5:00 p.m. one working day prior; or (B) acceptable evidence of receipt at Government installation before deadline.
Atomic_Propositions: P_14_301_f_1_late: Bid received after exact time; P_14_301_f_1_i: Received before award; P_14_301_f_1_ii: CO determines no undue delay; P_14_301_f_1_A: Electronic bid at initial entry by 5:00 p.m. one day prior; P_14_301_f_1_B: Acceptable evidence of timely receipt; P_14_301_f_1_consider: Late bid considered
Justification_Rules: Material Implication (Impl): Rule 15 [HIGH-RISK]; Conjunction (Conj): Rule 7; Disjunction (Add): Rule 8; Negation (Neg): Rule 10
Validation_Notes: Complex conditional: default is rejection of late bids. Exception requires three conjunctive conditions, where the third is a disjunction (electronic timing OR physical evidence). Nested negated implication. HIGH-RISK: multiple layers of implication and negation.

Natural_Language: The contracting officer will consider and may accept, a late modification of an otherwise successful bid, that makes its terms more favorable to the Government, at any time it is received.
Atomic_Propositions: P_14_301_f_2_cond: Late modification of successful bid makes terms more favorable; P_14_301_f_2_act: CO considers and may accept modification
Validation_Notes: 'Will consider' is mandatory; 'may accept' is permissive. Favorable modification of successful bid gets consideration at any time. Tautology for acceptance discretion.

Natural_Language: Acceptable evidence to establish the time of receipt at the Government installation includes the time/date stamp of that installation on the bid wrapper, other documentary evidence of receipt maintained by the installation, or oral testimony or statements of Government personnel.
Atomic_Propositions: P_14_301_g_a: Time/date stamp on wrapper; P_14_301_g_b: Other documentary evidence; P_14_301_g_c: Oral testimony or statements of Government personnel
Validation_Notes: Three disjunctive forms of acceptable evidence. 'Includes' with 'or' confirms any one is sufficient. List may not be exhaustive ('includes').

Natural_Language: If an emergency or unanticipated event interrupts normal Government processes so that bids cannot be received at the Government office designated for receipt of bids by the exact time specified in the IFB, and urgent Government requirements preclude amendment of the bid opening date, the time specified for receipt of bids will be deemed to be extended to the same time of day specified in the IFB on the first work day on which normal Government processes resume.
Atomic_Propositions: P_14_301_h_cond1: Emergency/unanticipated event interrupts normal processes; P_14_301_h_cond2: Bids cannot be received by specified time; P_14_301_h_cond3: Urgent requirements preclude amendment; P_14_301_h_act: Receipt time deemed extended to same time on first normal workday
Validation_Notes: Triple conjunctive condition triggers automatic extension. Extension is self-executing ('will be deemed'). No discretion involved.

Natural_Language: The contracting officer must promptly notify any bidder if its bid, modification, or withdrawal was received late, and must inform the bidder whether its bid will be considered, unless contract award is imminent and the notices prescribed in 14.309 would suffice.
Atomic_Propositions: P_14_301_i_cond: Bid/modification/withdrawal received late; P_14_301_i_a: CO promptly notifies bidder; P_14_301_i_b: CO informs whether bid will be considered; P_14_301_i_exc: Award imminent and 14.309 notices suffice
Justification_Rules: Material Implication (Impl): Rule 15 [HIGH-RISK]; Conjunction (Conj): Rule 7; Negation (Neg): Rule 10
Validation_Notes: Conditional notification with exception for imminent award. Two mandatory duties when exception does not apply.

Natural_Language: Late bids and modifications that are not considered must be held unopened, unless opened for identification, until after award and then retained with other unsuccessful bids. However, any bid bond or guarantee must be returned.
Atomic_Propositions: P_14_301_j_a: Unconsidered late bids held unopened until after award; P_14_301_j_b: Late bids retained with unsuccessful bids after award; P_14_301_j_c: Bid bond or guarantee returned
Validation_Notes: Three conjunctive handling requirements. Exception for opening for identification does not negate the holding requirement. Bond return is mandatory ('must').

Natural_Language: If available, the following must be included in the contract files for each late bid, modification, or withdrawal: (1) The date and hour of receipt; (2) A statement, with supporting rationale, regarding whether the bid was considered for award; (3) The envelope, wrapper, or other evidence of the date of receipt.
Atomic_Propositions: P_14_301_k_cond: Late bid documentation available; P_14_301_k_1: Date and hour of receipt; P_14_301_k_2: Statement with rationale on consideration; P_14_301_k_3: Envelope/wrapper/evidence of date
Validation_Notes: Conditional on availability. Three conjunctive documentation requirements. 'If available' softens the mandate slightly.

Natural_Language: If a bid received at the Government facility by electronic data interchange is unreadable to the degree that conformance to the essential requirements of the invitation for bids cannot be ascertained, the contracting officer must immediately notify the bidder that the bid will be rejected unless the bidder provides clear and convincing evidence: (a) Of the content of the bid as originally submitted; and (b) That the unreadable condition of the bid was caused by Government software or hardware error, malfunction, or other Government mishandling.
Atomic_Propositions: P_14_302_cond: EDI bid unreadable to degree conformance cannot be ascertained; P_14_302_notify: CO immediately notifies bidder of rejection; P_14_302_a: Evidence of original bid content; P_14_302_b: Evidence unreadable condition caused by Government error; P_14_302_save: Bid not rejected
Justification_Rules: Material Implication (Impl): Rule 15 [HIGH-RISK]; Conjunction (Conj): Rule 7; Negation (Neg): Rule 10
Validation_Notes: Conditional: unreadable bid triggers mandatory notification. Default is rejection unless bidder proves both content and Government causation. Two conjunctive evidence requirements. HIGH-RISK: nested implications.

Natural_Language: Bid opening.
Atomic_Propositions: P_14_303: Bid opening encompasses security, notification, public opening, classified handling, postponement, emergency extension, certification, and public inspection
Validation_Notes: Parent proposition for section 14.303.

Natural_Language: All bids (including modifications) received before the time set for the opening of bids must be secured in a locked bid box, a safe, or in a secure restricted-access electronic bid box (i.e., secure password protected file folder on a controlled access Government computer network).
Atomic_Propositions: P_14_303_a_a: All bids received before opening time secured in locked bid box, safe, or secure electronic bid box
Validation_Notes: Mandatory security requirement. Three disjunctive storage methods (locked box OR safe OR electronic box). 'Must' is unambiguous.

Natural_Language: The bid opening officer must inform those present at the public bid opening that the time set for the opening of bids has arrived.
Atomic_Propositions: P_14_303_b_a: Bid opening officer announces arrival of opening time
Validation_Notes: Simple mandatory procedural requirement.

Natural_Language: The bid opening officer must personally and publicly open all bids received before the exact time set for opening of bids and if practical, read the bids aloud to all present.
Atomic_Propositions: P_14_303_c_1_a: Officer personally and publicly opens all timely bids; P_14_303_c_1_b: Bids read aloud if practical
Validation_Notes: Two requirements: mandatory personal/public opening, and conditional aloud reading ('if practical'). Opening is mandatory; reading aloud is advisory when practical.

Natural_Language: The public may not attend bid openings for classified acquisitions. No public record must be made of bids or bid prices received in response to classified invitations for bids.
Atomic_Propositions: P_14_303_c_2_a: Public excluded from classified bid openings; P_14_303_c_2_b: No public record of classified bids or bid prices
Validation_Notes: Two conjunctive prohibitions for classified acquisitions. Both mandatory.

Natural_Language: The contracting officer may postpone the public bid opening if the contracting officer determines in writing there is reason to believe: (1) An important segment of bidders has been delayed in the mail; (2) Delays in the communications system specified for transmission of bids; (3) Circumstances beyond the control of the bidders have delayed their timely submission; or (4) Emergency or unanticipated events has interrupted normal Governmental processes so that the scheduled opening is impractical.
Atomic_Propositions: P_14_303_d_written: CO makes written determination; P_14_303_d_1: Important segment delayed in mail; P_14_303_d_2: Communications system delays; P_14_303_d_3: Circumstances beyond bidder control; P_14_303_d_4: Emergency/unanticipated events; P_14_303_d_act: Bid opening postponed
Justification_Rules: Material Implication (Impl): Rule 15 [HIGH-RISK]; Disjunction (Add): Rule 8; Conjunction (Conj): Rule 7; Tautology (Taut): Rule 18
Validation_Notes: Permissive 'may' with written determination and four disjunctive grounds. Written determination is mandatory prerequisite. Any one ground is sufficient. Tautology for discretion.

Natural_Language: Publicly post a determination to postpone a bid opening under paragraph (d). If practical before issuance of a formal amendment, communicate the determination to the prospective bidders likely to attend the scheduled bid opening.
Atomic_Propositions: P_14_303_e_a: Postponement determination publicly posted; P_14_303_e_b: If practical, communicate to prospective bidders before formal amendment
Validation_Notes: Two conjunctive duties: mandatory posting and conditional pre-amendment communication.

Natural_Language: In the case of paragraph (d)(4), and when urgent Government requirements preclude amendment of the IFB, the time specified for opening of bids will be deemed to be extended to the same time of day specified in the IFB on the first workday on which normal Government processes resume. The time of actual bid opening must be deemed to be the time set for bid opening for the purpose of determining late bids under section 14.301.
Atomic_Propositions: P_14_303_f_cond1: Emergency per (d)(4); P_14_303_f_cond2: Urgent requirements preclude amendment; P_14_303_f_a: Opening time deemed extended to same time on first normal workday; P_14_303_f_b: Actual opening time deemed the set time for late bid purposes
Validation_Notes: Dual condition triggers automatic extension and legal fiction for late bid determination. Self-executing ('will be deemed'). Parallel to P_14_301_h but for bid opening rather than bid receipt.

Natural_Language: The bid opening officer must complete and certify the accuracy of the Standard Form 1409, Abstract of Offers, or Optional Form 1419, Abstract of Offers-Construction (or automated equivalent) as soon after bid opening as practicable.
Atomic_Propositions: P_14_303_g_a: SF 1409 or OF 1419 (or equivalent) completed and certified accurately; P_14_303_g_b: Completed as soon after opening as practicable
Validation_Notes: Two conjunctive requirements: completion/certification and timeliness. 'Must' is mandatory.

Natural_Language: Abstracts of offers for unclassified acquisitions must be available for public inspection.
Atomic_Propositions: P_14_303_h_a: Unclassified offer abstracts available for public inspection
Validation_Notes: Mandatory public access requirement. Simple atomic.

Natural_Language: Mistakes in bids - General.
Atomic_Propositions: P_14_304_1: General rules encompass examination, correction authority limits, verification, and processing
Validation_Notes: Parent proposition for section 14.304-1.

Natural_Language: After the opening of bids, contracting officers must examine all bids for mistakes.
Atomic_Propositions: P_14_304_1_a_a: After opening, COs examine all bids for mistakes
Validation_Notes: Mandatory post-opening duty. 'Must examine' is unambiguous.

Natural_Language: The authority to permit correction of bids is limited to bids that, as submitted, are responsive to the invitation. The authority does not permit correction of bids to make them responsive.
Atomic_Propositions: P_14_304_1_b_a: Correction authority limited to responsive bids; P_14_304_1_b_b: Cannot correct to make bids responsive
Validation_Notes: Two conjunctive limitations on correction authority. Critical distinction between correcting responsive bids (allowed) and making nonresponsive bids responsive (prohibited).

Natural_Language: If the contracting officer identifies an apparent mistake or has reason to believe that a mistake exists the contracting officer must request the bidder verify its bid, calling attention to the suspected mistake.
Atomic_Propositions: P_14_304_1_c_cond: CO identifies apparent mistake or has reason to believe one exists; P_14_304_1_c_act: CO requests bidder verify, calling attention to suspected mistake
Validation_Notes: Conditional: apparent mistake or reason to believe triggers mandatory verification request. Disjunctive trigger (identifies OR has reason).

Natural_Language: If the bidder asserts a mistake in its bid, the matter must be processed in accordance with section 14.304. Such actions must be taken before award.
Atomic_Propositions: P_14_304_1_d_cond: Bidder asserts mistake; P_14_304_1_d_a: Processed per section 14.304; P_14_304_1_d_b: Actions taken before award
Validation_Notes: Conditional: assertion triggers mandatory processing per 14.304 and pre-award timing requirement.

Natural_Language: The contracting officer may correct any clerical mistake, apparent on its face in the bid, before award. The contracting officer first must obtain from the bidder a verification of the bid intended. Examples of apparent mistakes are obvious: (a) Misplacement of a decimal point; (b) Incorrect discounts; (c) Reversal of the price f.o.b. destination and price f.o.b. origin; and (d) Mistake in designation of unit.
Atomic_Propositions: P_14_304_2_cond: Clerical mistake apparent on face of bid; P_14_304_2_a: CO may correct before award; P_14_304_2_b: CO must first obtain bidder verification; P_14_304_2_ex_a: Misplacement of decimal point; P_14_304_2_ex_b: Incorrect discounts; P_14_304_2_ex_c: Reversal of FOB prices; P_14_304_2_ex_d: Mistake in unit designation
Justification_Rules: Material Implication (Impl): Rule 15 [HIGH-RISK]; Conjunction (Conj): Rule 7; Tautology (Taut): Rule 18
Validation_Notes: Permissive correction ('may') with mandatory prerequisite verification ('must first'). Tautology for correction discretion. If exercised, verification is mandatory. Examples are illustrative.

Natural_Language: A bidder may request in writing permission from the contracting officer to correct a mistake after providing clear and convincing evidence that establishes both the existence of the mistake, and the bid actually intended. If the contracting officer accepts the evidence and the correction does not cause the bidder to outbid other lower bids, the contracting officer may allow the correction.
Atomic_Propositions: P_14_304_3_a_1_req: Written request with clear and convincing evidence of mistake and intended bid; P_14_304_3_a_1_accept: CO accepts evidence; P_14_304_3_a_1_nooutbid: Correction does not cause outbidding; P_14_304_3_a_1_act: CO allows correction
Justification_Rules: Material Implication (Impl): Rule 15 [HIGH-RISK]; Conjunction (Conj): Rule 7; Tautology (Taut): Rule 18
Validation_Notes: Permissive 'may' for CO. Three conjunctive conditions for eligibility. Clear and convincing is the evidence standard. Tautology for CO discretion.

Natural_Language: If the correction causes the bidder to outbid one or more otherwise lower bids, the head of the agency may make a determination to permit the correction only if the mistake and intended bid are obvious from the final bid documents.
Atomic_Propositions: P_14_304_3_a_2_cond: Correction would cause outbidding; P_14_304_3_a_2_obvious: Mistake and intended bid obvious from final documents; P_14_304_3_a_2_act: Agency head permits correction
Justification_Rules: Material Implication (Impl): Rule 15 [HIGH-RISK]; Conjunction (Conj): Rule 7; Tautology (Taut): Rule 18
Validation_Notes: Elevated authority (agency head vs CO). 'Only if' makes obviousness a necessary condition. Permissive 'may' even when conditions met. Higher evidence standard than (a)(1).

Natural_Language: If bidder requests withdrawal not correction, evidence clear and convincing as to mistake and intended bid, and bid is lowest both uncorrected and corrected, agency head may correct and not permit withdrawal.
Atomic_Propositions: P_14_304_3_b_1: Bidder requests withdrawal; P_14_304_3_b_2: Clear/convincing evidence; P_14_304_3_b_3: Bid lowest both ways; P_14_304_3_b_act: Agency head corrects, denies withdrawal
Justification_Rules: Material Implication (Impl): Rule 15 [HIGH-RISK]; Conjunction (Conj): Rule 7; Tautology (Taut): Rule 18
Validation_Notes: Permissive agency head authority to override withdrawal request. Three conjunctive conditions. Tautology for discretion.

Natural_Language: If evidence clear as to mistake but not intended bid, or evidence reasonably supports mistake but not clear and convincing, official above CO may permit withdrawal.
Atomic_Propositions: P_14_304_3_c_1: Evidence clear re mistake not intended bid; P_14_304_3_c_2: Evidence reasonable but not clear/convincing; P_14_304_3_c_act: Official above CO may permit withdrawal
Justification_Rules: Material Implication (Impl): Rule 15 [HIGH-RISK]; Disjunction (Add): Rule 8; Tautology (Taut): Rule 18
Validation_Notes: Two disjunctive evidence scenarios. Lower standard than (a). Withdrawal only.

Natural_Language: If evidence does not warrant determination under (a), (b), or (c), agency head may determine bid neither withdrawn nor corrected.
Atomic_Propositions: P_14_304_3_d_cond: Evidence insufficient under (a)-(c); P_14_304_3_d_act: Agency head determines no change
Validation_Notes: Catch-all. Permissive. Bid stands.

Natural_Language: Agency heads may delegate authority for (a)-(d) determinations to central authority without power of redelegation.
Atomic_Propositions: P_14_304_3_e_a: Delegation permissive; P_14_304_3_e_b: No redelegation
Validation_Notes: Permissive delegation with mandatory redelegation prohibition.

Natural_Language: Legal counsel must concur before issuance of determinations.
Atomic_Propositions: P_14_304_3_f_a: Legal counsel concurrence before determinations
Validation_Notes: Mandatory prerequisite.

Natural_Language: Mere statement by administrative officials of satisfaction that error was made is insufficient.
Atomic_Propositions: P_14_304_3_g_1_a: Administrative satisfaction statement is insufficient evidence
Validation_Notes: Evidence threshold prohibition.

Natural_Language: CO must immediately request verification. Actions must reasonably assure no error or elicit allegation. Bidder should be advised of: bid much lower; unusual specs; changes from previous; other info indicating mistake.
Atomic_Propositions: P_14_304_3_g_2_a: Immediate verification request; P_14_304_3_g_2_b: Reasonable assurance actions; P_14_304_3_g_2_c: Appropriate advisement to bidder
Validation_Notes: Three duties. Advisory 'should' on advisement items. PENDING_REVIEW.

Natural_Language: If bid verified, consider as originally submitted.
Atomic_Propositions: P_14_304_3_g_3_cond: Bid verified; P_14_304_3_g_3_act: Bid considered as submitted
Validation_Notes: Mandatory consequence of verification.

Natural_Language: If acceptance time likely to expire, request all eligible bidders extend.
Atomic_Propositions: P_14_304_3_g_4_cond: Time expiring; P_14_304_3_g_4_act: Request extensions
Validation_Notes: Mandatory extension request.

Natural_Language: If bidder cannot grant extension, consider bid as originally submitted.
Atomic_Propositions: P_14_304_3_g_5_cond: No extension granted; P_14_304_3_g_5_act: Bid stands
Validation_Notes: Mandatory consequence.

Natural_Language: If bidder alleges mistake, CO must advise written request with sworn statements and evidence including file copy, worksheets, subcontractor quotes, price lists, and other evidence.
Atomic_Propositions: P_14_304_3_g_6_cond: Bidder alleges mistake; P_14_304_3_g_6_a: CO advises written request; P_14_304_3_g_6_b: Evidence requirements
Validation_Notes: Conditional duty with evidence requirements.

Natural_Language: When bidder furnishes evidence, CO must refer case with: signed bid copy; IFB and specs; abstract of bids; bidder request and evidence; CO statement with description, dates, allegation details, evidence summary, price reference, additional evidence, and recommendation.
Atomic_Propositions: P_14_304_3_g_7_cond: Evidence furnished; P_14_304_3_g_7_docs: Five categories of referral documentation
Validation_Notes: Conditional: mandatory case referral with comprehensive documentation.

Natural_Language: If bidder fails to furnish evidence, consider bid as submitted unless amount so far out of line or other clear error indications. CO must document all attempts.
Atomic_Propositions: P_14_304_3_g_8_cond: No evidence from bidder; P_14_304_3_g_8_default: Bid stands; P_14_304_3_g_8_exc1: Amount out of line; P_14_304_3_g_8_exc2: Clear error indications; P_14_304_3_g_8_doc: Documentation of attempts
Justification_Rules: Material Implication (Impl): Rule 15 [HIGH-RISK]; Negation (Neg): Rule 10; Disjunction (Add): Rule 8
Validation_Notes: Default with two disjunctive exceptions. Documentation mandatory regardless.

Natural_Language: Agency must maintain records of all determinations, facts, and actions. Copies in file.
Atomic_Propositions: P_14_304_3_h_a: Records maintained; P_14_304_3_h_b: Copies in file
Validation_Notes: Mandatory record-keeping.

Natural_Language: Nothing prevents submission of doubtful cases to Comptroller General.
Atomic_Propositions: P_14_304_3_i_a: Comptroller General referral preserved
Validation_Notes: Savings clause.

Natural_Language: Unless compelling reason to reject all bids and cancel, CO must award to lowest responsive responsible bidder.
Atomic_Propositions: P_14_305_a_cond: No compelling reason; P_14_305_a_act: Award to lowest responsive responsible bidder
Validation_Notes: Default award rule. Core sealed bidding principle.

Natural_Language: Invitations may be cancelled after opening when agency head determines in writing for ten disjunctive reasons: inadequate specs; revised specs; no longer required; cost factors not considered; less expensive alternative; unreasonable prices/single bid; collusion/bad faith; no responsive responsible bid; A-76 shows Government more economical; or other public interest reasons.
Atomic_Propositions: P_14_305_b_written: Written determination; P_14_305_b_reasons: Ten disjunctive grounds; P_14_305_b_act: Post-opening cancellation
Justification_Rules: Material Implication (Impl): Rule 15 [HIGH-RISK]; Disjunction (Add): Rule 8; Tautology (Taut): Rule 18
Validation_Notes: Permissive with written determination and ten disjunctive grounds. Agency head authority.

Natural_Language: If award delayed beyond acceptance periods, CO should request written extensions with surety consent.
Atomic_Propositions: P_14_305_c_cond: Delay beyond acceptance; P_14_305_c_act: Request extensions
Validation_Notes: Advisory 'should'. PENDING_REVIEW.

Natural_Language: If cancelled for (b)(6)-(8) and agency head authorized negotiation, proceed per (e).
Atomic_Propositions: P_14_305_d_1_cond: Cancelled for (b)(6)-(8) with negotiation authority; P_14_305_d_1_act: Proceed per (e)
Validation_Notes: Mandatory consequence.

Natural_Language: If cancelled for (b)(1),(2),(4),(5),(10), or (b)(6)-(8) without negotiation authority, proceed with new acquisition.
Atomic_Propositions: P_14_305_d_2_cond: Other cancellation scenarios; P_14_305_d_2_act: New acquisition
Validation_Notes: Covers remaining cancellation scenarios.

Natural_Language: When agency head determines cancellation and negotiation in Government interest per (d)(1), CO may negotiate per part 15 and award without new IFB provided: (1) each responsible bidder given notice and opportunity to participate; and (2) award to responsible bidder offering lowest negotiated price.
Atomic_Propositions: P_14_305_e_cond: Agency head determined per (d)(1); P_14_305_e_1: Each responsible bidder notified and given opportunity; P_14_305_e_2: Award to lowest negotiated price
Justification_Rules: Material Implication (Impl): Rule 15 [HIGH-RISK]; Conjunction (Conj): Rule 7; Tautology (Taut): Rule 18
Validation_Notes: Permissive negotiation authority with two mandatory conditions. Tautology for CO discretion. Nested implication: outer condition enables, inner conditions constrain.

Natural_Language: To be considered for award, a bid must comply in all material respects with the invitation for bids.
Atomic_Propositions: P_14_306_1_a_a: Bid complies in all material respects with IFB; P_14_306_1_a_b: Bid considered for award
Validation_Notes: Foundational responsiveness standard. Non-compliance precludes consideration. Contrapositive of: consideration implies compliance.

Natural_Language: Bids on own form or letter considered only if: (1) bidder accepts all terms and conditions; and (2) award results in binding contract with same terms.
Atomic_Propositions: P_14_306_1_b_1: Bidder accepts all terms; P_14_306_1_b_2: Binding contract with same terms
Validation_Notes: Nested conditional: own-form use triggers two conjunctive conditions for consideration.

Natural_Language: Electronic bids considered only if method stipulated or permitted by IFB.
Atomic_Propositions: P_14_306_1_c_cond: Electronic bid; P_14_306_1_c_req: Method stipulated or permitted
Validation_Notes: 'Only if' creates necessary condition.

Natural_Language: If any sample fails to conform to listed characteristics, bid rejected as nonresponsive.
Atomic_Propositions: P_14_306_1_d_cond: Sample fails to conform
Validation_Notes: Mandatory rejection. No discretion.

Natural_Language: Prior to award, CO must determine: (1) apparent awardee is responsible (see subpart 9.1); and (2) prices offered are reasonable and not materially unbalanced.
Atomic_Propositions: P_14_306_2_a_1: Awardee responsible per 9.1; P_14_306_2_a_2: Prices reasonable and not unbalanced
Validation_Notes: Two conjunctive mandatory pre-award determinations.

Natural_Language: Part 15 price analysis techniques should be used as guidelines for determining reasonableness and material unbalancing.
Atomic_Propositions: P_14_306_2_b_a: Part 15 techniques used as guidelines
Validation_Notes: Advisory 'should'. Not mandatory.

Natural_Language: Determination in light of all prevailing circumstances. Particular care with single bids.
Atomic_Propositions: P_14_306_2_c_a: All circumstances considered; P_14_306_2_c_b: Particular care with single bids
Validation_Notes: Two mandatory requirements. Both 'must'.

Natural_Language: Bids failing to conform to basic IFB requirements must be rejected.
Atomic_Propositions: P_14_306_3_a_cond: Nonconformance; P_14_306_3_a_act: Rejected
Validation_Notes: Mandatory rejection. Core responsiveness rule.

Natural_Language: Nonconforming bids rejected unless invitation authorized alternates and alternates meet requirements.
Atomic_Propositions: P_14_306_3_b_cond: Nonconforming; P_14_306_3_b_exc1: Alternates authorized; P_14_306_3_b_exc2: Alternates meet requirements
Justification_Rules: Material Implication (Impl): Rule 15 [HIGH-RISK]; Conjunction (Conj): Rule 7; Negation (Neg): Rule 10
Validation_Notes: Default rejection with two conjunctive exception conditions.

Natural_Language: Bids failing delivery schedule or permissible alternates must be rejected.
Atomic_Propositions: P_14_306_3_c_cond: Delivery nonconformance
Validation_Notes: Mandatory rejection for delivery nonconformance.

Natural_Language: Bids rejected if bidder imposes modifying conditions or limits liability. Examples: protects against future cost changes; fails to state price; qualifies price to delivery time; conditions on separate IFB; requires Government to determine compliance; limits Government rights.
Atomic_Propositions: P_14_306_3_d_cond: Bidder imposes modifying conditions or limits liability
Validation_Notes: Mandatory rejection. Six illustrative examples not exhaustive.

Natural_Language: Low bidder may be requested to delete non-substantive objectionable conditions not working injustice on others. Substance affects price, quantity, quality, or delivery.
Atomic_Propositions: P_14_306_3_e_cond1: Non-substantive; P_14_306_3_e_cond2: No injustice
Justification_Rules: Material Implication (Impl): Rule 15 [HIGH-RISK]; Conjunction (Conj): Rule 7; Tautology (Taut): Rule 18
Validation_Notes: Permissive 'may' with two conjunctive conditions. Tautology for discretion.

Natural_Language: CO may reject any bid if written determination of unreasonable total or line item prices.
Atomic_Propositions: P_14_306_3_f_cond: Written unreasonableness determination
Validation_Notes: Permissive rejection requiring written determination.

Natural_Language: CO may reject any bid if prices materially unbalanced (see part 15).
Atomic_Propositions: P_14_306_3_g_cond: Material unbalancing
Validation_Notes: Permissive rejection for material unbalancing.

Natural_Language: CO must reject bid from suspended/debarred/proposed/ineligible person at opening date unless written compelling reason (see subpart 9.4).
Atomic_Propositions: P_14_306_3_h_cond: Bidder excluded; P_14_306_3_h_exc: Written compelling reason
Justification_Rules: Material Implication (Impl): Rule 15 [HIGH-RISK]; Conjunction (Conj): Rule 7; Negation (Neg): Rule 10
Validation_Notes: Mandatory rejection with narrow written exception.

Natural_Language: Reject low bids from not-responsible concerns per part 9, unless small business (see part 19 re COC).
Atomic_Propositions: P_14_306_3_i_cond: Not responsible; P_14_306_3_i_exc: Small business
Validation_Notes: Mandatory rejection with small business exception via COC process.

Natural_Language: Reject bid when guarantee required and bidder fails to furnish per IFB, except as provided in part 28.
Atomic_Propositions: P_14_306_3_j_cond1: Guarantee required; P_14_306_3_j_cond2: Not furnished; P_14_306_3_j_exc: Part 28 exception
Justification_Rules: Material Implication (Impl): Rule 15 [HIGH-RISK]; Conjunction (Conj): Rule 7; Negation (Neg): Rule 10
Validation_Notes: Triple condition with Part 28 exception.

Natural_Language: Preserve originals of all rejected bids and written findings in contract file.
Atomic_Propositions: P_14_306_3_k_a: Originals preserved; P_14_306_3_k_b: Written findings preserved
Validation_Notes: Two conjunctive record requirements. Mandatory.

Natural_Language: If bidder assets transferred between opening and award, reject unless by merger, operation of law, or non-barred means per 41 U.S.C. 6305 or 31 U.S.C. 3727.
Atomic_Propositions: P_14_306_3_l_cond: Assets transferred; P_14_306_3_l_exc: Transfer by permitted means
Validation_Notes: Mandatory rejection with statutory exceptions.

Natural_Language: When all bids rejected, CO must notify each bidder and provide reason.
Atomic_Propositions: P_14_306_4_cond: All bids rejected; P_14_306_4_a: Notification; P_14_306_4_b: Reason provided
Validation_Notes: Two mandatory duties upon total rejection.

Natural_Language: Bid with descriptive literature restriction preventing public disclosure renders bid nonresponsive if prohibits disclosure of essential info. Does not apply to unsolicited non-qualifying literature.
Atomic_Propositions: P_14_306_5_cond1: Restricted literature; P_14_306_5_cond2: Prohibits essential disclosure; P_14_306_5_exc: Unsolicited non-qualifying
Justification_Rules: Material Implication (Impl): Rule 15 [HIGH-RISK]; Conjunction (Conj): Rule 7; Negation (Neg): Rule 10
Validation_Notes: Triple condition for nonresponsive determination.

Natural_Language: All-or-none bid may be responsive unless IFB provides otherwise. Cannot withdraw or modify all-or-none after opening.
Atomic_Propositions: P_14_306_6_a: Responsive unless IFB otherwise; P_14_306_6_b: No post-opening withdrawal/modification
Validation_Notes: Two independent rules. Prohibition protects other bidders.

Natural_Language: Minor informality/irregularity is form not substance, negligible effect. CO must give opportunity to cure or waive, whichever advantages Government. Examples: copies, employee info, unsigned bid with intent, amendment acknowledgment, EO/AA representations.
Atomic_Propositions: P_14_306_7_cond: Minor informality exists; P_14_306_7_act: CO cures or waives per Government advantage
Validation_Notes: Mandatory cure-or-waive duty. CO chooses per Government advantage.

Natural_Language: Prompt payment discounts must not be considered in evaluation of bids.
Atomic_Propositions: P_14_306_8_a: Discounts excluded from evaluation
Validation_Notes: Absolute prohibition. No exceptions.

Natural_Language: When IFB has no EPA clause but bidder proposes one with ceiling, evaluate at maximum possible EPA of base price.
Atomic_Propositions: P_14_306_9_a_1_cond: No EPA clause, bidder proposes with ceiling
Validation_Notes: Mandatory maximum-EPA evaluation.

Natural_Language: If bid eligible, request bidder agree to approved EPA clause per part 16. If refuses, CO may award on original bid.
Atomic_Propositions: P_14_306_9_a_2_cond: Eligible; P_14_306_9_a_2_refuse: Refuses clause
Validation_Notes: Sequential conditionals: request then permissive fallback.

Natural_Language: Reject bids with EPA and no ceiling unless clear evaluation basis exists.
Atomic_Propositions: P_14_306_9_a_3_cond: EPA no ceiling no clear basis
Validation_Notes: Mandatory rejection with exception.

Natural_Language: When Government EPA clause and no exceptions, evaluate on quoted prices without EPA.
Atomic_Propositions: P_14_306_9_b_1_cond: Government EPA, no exceptions
Validation_Notes: Base-price evaluation when Government EPA accepted.

Natural_Language: Reject as nonresponsive if bidder increases max EPA percentage or limits downward adjustment.
Atomic_Propositions: P_14_306_9_b_2_cond: Increases or limits
Validation_Notes: Mandatory rejection. Disjunctive trigger.

Natural_Language: Reject as nonresponsive if bid deletes EPA clause.
Atomic_Propositions: P_14_306_9_b_3_cond: EPA clause deleted
Validation_Notes: Mandatory rejection. Deletion limits downward provisions.

Natural_Language: When bidder decreases max EPA, evaluate at base price equally. If in position for award, award reflects lower ceiling.
Atomic_Propositions: P_14_306_9_b_4_cond: Bidder decreases max EPA
Validation_Notes: Two-stage: equal evaluation then reflect lower ceiling if awarded.

Natural_Language: Award.
Atomic_Propositions: P_14_307: Award encompasses procedure, multiple awards, partial awards, documents, forms, discounts
Validation_Notes: Parent proposition for section 14.307.

Natural_Language: CO must make award: (1) by written or electronic notice; (2) within acceptance time or extension; (3) to responsible bidder whose conforming bid most advantageous considering only price and price-related factors.
Atomic_Propositions: P_14_307_a_1: Written/electronic notice; P_14_307_a_2: Within acceptance time; P_14_307_a_3: Most advantageous conforming responsible bid
Validation_Notes: Three conjunctive mandatory award requirements. Core sealed bidding standard.

Natural_Language: Multiple awards from single IFB require separate award documents.
Atomic_Propositions: P_14_307_b_cond: Multiple awards
Validation_Notes: Conditional: multiple awards trigger separate documents.

Natural_Language: Partial award with items withheld: IFB and award must state subsequent awards possible within acceptance period.
Atomic_Propositions: P_14_307_c_cond: Partial award
Validation_Notes: Mandatory statement in both IFB and award document.

Natural_Language: All IFB provisions including acceptable bid changes must be clearly set forth in award document.
Atomic_Propositions: P_14_307_d_a: Completeness of award document
Validation_Notes: Mandatory completeness requirement.

Natural_Language: Award generally on SF 33 or SF 1447. If further changes, bilateral on SF 26.
Atomic_Propositions: P_14_307_e_1_a: Default SF 33/1447; P_14_307_e_1_b: Changes trigger SF 26
Validation_Notes: Default with conditional for further changes.

Natural_Language: Standard form use does not preclude informal notices including electronic.
Atomic_Propositions: P_14_307_e_2_a: Informal notices compatible
Validation_Notes: Permissive clarification.

Natural_Language: Do not physically include Part IV. Award acceptance on SF 33/26/1447 incorporates Section K even if not attached.
Atomic_Propositions: P_14_307_e_3_a: Part IV excluded physically; P_14_307_e_3_b: Section K incorporated by operation
Validation_Notes: Prohibition plus automatic incorporation.

Natural_Language: Discount forms part of award; payment center takes if timely. Alternative: invoice-level discounts. See 52.232-8.
Atomic_Propositions: P_14_307_f_a: Discount in award; P_14_307_f_b: Payment center duty; P_14_307_f_c: Invoice alternative
Validation_Notes: Three elements: integration, duty, and alternative.

Natural_Language: Equal low bids: award in priority order: (1) SB + labor surplus area; (2) other SB; (3) other business.
Atomic_Propositions: P_14_308_a_1: SB labor surplus first; P_14_308_a_2: Other SB second; P_14_308_a_3: Other business third
Validation_Notes: Sequential priority order. Mandatory.

Natural_Language: If still equal after priorities, conduct drawing with at least three witnesses. Give bidders opportunity to attend if time permits. File must contain witness names/addresses.
Atomic_Propositions: P_14_308_b_cond: Still equal after priorities
Validation_Notes: Three conjunctive requirements when drawing needed.

Natural_Language: When using priorities, CO must include written agreement that contractor performs per priority justification.
Atomic_Propositions: P_14_308_c_cond: Priority-based award
Validation_Notes: Mandatory written agreement when priority used.

Natural_Language: CO must (subject to part 9): notify unsuccessful bidders within three calendar days; when award to other than low bidder, state reason to unsuccessful low bidders.
Atomic_Propositions: P_14_309_1_a_1: Notify within 3 days; P_14_309_1_a_2: State reason if not low bidder awarded
Validation_Notes: Two mandatory notification duties. 'Day' means calendar day excluding weekends/holidays at end.

Natural_Language: For WTO GPA/FTA acquisitions (part 25), notices to unsuccessful bidders from covered countries must include: dollar amount of successful bid; and name/address of successful bidder.
Atomic_Propositions: P_14_309_1_b_cond: WTO GPA/FTA acquisition; P_14_309_1_b_1: Dollar amount; P_14_309_1_b_2: Name/address
Validation_Notes: Conditional: international agreement triggers two additional notice requirements.

Natural_Language: For classified contracts: in addition to 14.309-1, advise unsuccessful bidders including non-bidders on disposition of classified info. May provide name/price upon request. No telephone for classified award info.
Atomic_Propositions: P_14_309_2_a: Disposition advice; P_14_309_2_b: Name/price on request; P_14_309_2_c: No telephone
Validation_Notes: Three elements: mandatory disposition advice, permissive name/price, prohibition on telephone.

Natural_Language: Mistakes after award - processed under part 33 and the following.
Atomic_Propositions: P_14_401: Post-award mistake procedures
Validation_Notes: Parent proposition for section 14.401.

Natural_Language: When mistake not discovered until after award, correct by contract modification if favorable to Government without changing essential spec requirements.
Atomic_Propositions: P_14_401_a_cond: Post-award mistake; P_14_401_a_fav: Favorable to Government; P_14_401_a_spec: Does not change essential specs
Validation_Notes: Triple condition for modification authority.

Natural_Language: Agencies may determine: rescind; reform to delete items or increase price (if corrected price does not exceed next lowest bid); or no change if evidence does not warrant.
Atomic_Propositions: P_14_401_b_1: Rescind; P_14_401_b_2: Reform (delete or increase); P_14_401_b_3: No change
Validation_Notes: Three disjunctive determination options. Permissive 'authorized' and 'may'. Price increase limited to next lowest bid.

Natural_Language: Determinations under (b)(1) and (2) require clear and convincing evidence of mistake. Must also be clear mistake was mutual, or if unilateral, so apparent as to charge CO with notice.
Atomic_Propositions: P_14_401_c_a: Clear and convincing evidence; P_14_401_c_b: Mutual mistake or apparent unilateral
Validation_Notes: Two conjunctive evidence requirements. Second is disjunctive (mutual OR apparent).

Natural_Language: Each proposed determination must be coordinated with legal counsel per agency procedures.
Atomic_Propositions: P_14_401_d_a: Legal counsel coordination
Validation_Notes: Mandatory legal review. 'Must' is unambiguous.

Natural_Language: CO must request contractor support alleged mistake with: file copy of bid; original worksheets/data; subcontractor/supplier quotations; published price lists; any other evidence establishing mistake, manner, and intended bid.
Atomic_Propositions: P_14_401_e_1_a: File copy; P_14_401_e_1_b: Worksheets; P_14_401_e_1_c: Sub quotes; P_14_401_e_1_d: Price lists; P_14_401_e_1_e: Other evidence
Validation_Notes: Five conjunctive evidence categories. 'Such as' makes list illustrative. All categories mandatory to request.

Natural_Language: Case file must contain: all contractor evidence; signed CO statement (describing supplies, how/when alleged, evidence summary, recent price/estimate, CO opinion on bona fide/notice, recommended action, performance/payment status); signed bid copy; IFB and specs; bid abstract; reform/rescind request and correspondence; contract and change orders.
Atomic_Propositions: P_14_401_e_2_i: Contractor evidence; P_14_401_e_2_ii: CO statement with 7 elements; P_14_401_e_2_iii: Bid copy; P_14_401_e_2_iv: IFB/specs; P_14_401_e_2_v: Abstract; P_14_401_e_2_vi: Request/correspondence; P_14_401_e_2_vii: Contract/change orders
Validation_Notes: Seven conjunctive case file components. CO statement alone has seven internal elements. Comprehensive documentation requirement.

Natural_Language: Agency must include in contract file: all determinations per 14.401; facts involved; action taken in each case.
Atomic_Propositions: P_14_401_f_1: Determinations; P_14_401_f_2: Facts; P_14_401_f_3: Actions
Validation_Notes: Three conjunctive record requirements. Mandatory.

Natural_Language: See part 15 for cost and price negotiation policies and procedures.
Atomic_Propositions: P_14_402_a: Follow part 15 for pricing modifications
Validation_Notes: Simple cross-reference. No independent requirement.
